content.title: Framer Framed
content.short_description: A server-rendered archive website built with Node.js, LiquidJS, and TinyHTTP.
content.long_description: A flexible, component-based web application for the Framer Framed archive, with reusable Liquid templates, a lightweight Node.js back end, and interactive front-end search.

content.title: HCD
content.short_description: An accessible keyboard concept designed around a real user’s needs.
content.long_description: A human-centred design project exploring a more accurate, less tiring mobile typing experience for a stylus user with limited comfort while travelling.

content.title: API 2425
content.short_description: A server-rendered web app built with TinyHTTP, Liquid, and Vite.
content.long_description: A Node.js web application with a Vite-powered front end and a TinyHTTP and LiquidJS back end, deployed as a live API project.

content.title: Browser Tech
content.short_description: A progressive web-form project focused on accessible HTML.
content.long_description: A browser technology project exploring well-structured, accessible forms and progressively enhanced web experiences.

content.title: CSS for the Rescue
content.short_description: An interactive control-panel interface built with CSS.
content.long_description: A CSS-focused project that develops a playful, expandable control panel with custom properties and a range of interactive controls.

content.title: WAFS
content.short_description: A web application for flight scheduling.
content.long_description: A web application for planning and managing flights, designed with an emphasis on performance and user experience.

content.title: Game Mate Finder
content.short_description: A platform that helps gamers find people to play with.
content.long_description: A full-stack web application for connecting gamers by their interests, favourite genres, and preferred consoles. It includes accounts, profiles, game information, and friend requests.
